import pandas as pd

# Load source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_97/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_97/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_97_0 and Source3_97_2 on 'movie id'
merged = pd.merge(source0, source2, on="movie id", how="inner")

# Group by 'movie title' and calculate average rating
result = merged.groupby("movie title", as_index=False)["rating"].mean()

# Ensure correct column types
result["movie title"] = result["movie title"].astype(str)
result["rating"] = result["rating"].astype(float)

# Save to target path
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_97/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
